subject: Model-mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@brightlayer.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Model-mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer)

Hi Samantha / Jared —

Great to chat today. Quick recap and next steps based on our discovery:

Summary of expected monthly volumes (as discussed):
- Chat (user-facing assistants): ~15M input tokens / month, ~30M output tokens / month (total ~45M tokens)
- Embeddings (semantic search + recommender): ~8M embedding units / month
- Rerank (batch reranking on candidate sets): ~2M tokens / month

Proposed model mix (initial):
- chat: gpt-3.5-style open model variant for bulk; 10% traffic to a higher-quality chat model for complex flows
- embeddings: dense-open-embedding v2
- rerank: specialized reranker model (small)

Cost/price target you shared: goal is target $/1M tokens around $400–$600 depending on model mix and SLA. You mentioned a $/month budget band of $6k–$10k to start (pilot), scaled to $60k+/month if we hit production volumes.

Action items I’m taking:
- Attach MA-Planner.xlsx with token-volume worksheet and rough unit-econ calc (attached).
- Rishi will provide a sketch of per-model unit economics (est. $/1M tokens by model) and recommended routing rules.
- Schedule follow-up next week to align on contract cadence and any security questionnaire items.

Samantha — can you confirm the per-flow splits above (chat vs embeddings vs rerank) and the target pilot budget? If you have a preferred procurement timeline, share that and I’ll align our legal/finance touchpoints.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments:
- MA-Planner.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 96 KB)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@brightlayer.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model-mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer)

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Pilot budget: we can commit to $8k/month for a 6–8 week pilot. Production target after pilot is ~$65k/month.
- Per-flow confirmation: your splits match our model: chat ~55% of tokens, embeddings ~30% of embedding units, rerank ~15% (token-equivalent). For chat, the 10% high-quality tier for complex dialogs sounds right.
- Volume skew: we expect spikes when new features launch (20–30% week-over-week increases for the first month).

Next steps for us: we need a back-of-envelope pricing table (per-model $/1M tokens) and an SOW draft for procurement. Can you route that to our procurement contact (cc’d: Jared)?

—Samantha
Sr. PM, AI Products | BrightLayer
samantha.lee@brightlayer.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model-mix & pricing follow-up (BrightLayer)

Hi all — quick unit-econ sketch per Marissa’s ask. These are ballpark estimates for the models discussed; final pricing will depend on SLA, retention, and committed volume.

Estimated $/1M tokens (redwood hosted API, no commitment):
- chat (base open model): $550 / 1M tokens
- chat (higher-quality tier): $1,800 / 1M tokens
- embeddings (dense-open-embedding-v2): $250 / 1M embedding units
- rerank (small reranker): $300 / 1M tokens

Suggested routing & unit-econ approach:
- Route 90% chat traffic to base model, 10% to HQ model for the ~complex flows. Effective blended chat rate ~($550 * .9 + $1,800 * .1) = ~$715 / 1M tokens.
- If BrightLayer commits to a 3–6 month reserved capacity (dedicated pools), we can offer ~25–40% discount depending on commit level and SLA.
- For embeddings, batching and quantized serving often pushes the effective cost down 20–30% at scale; we’ll model that in the SOW.

I’ll attach a quick worksheet to the MA-Planner with the blended numbers and scenarios (pilot vs. production).

- Rishi
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Thanks for the confirmation, Samantha — great to have the pilot budget and production target. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Rishi will finalize the per-model pricing scenarios and attach them to the MA-Planner.
2) I’ll drop an SOW-draft.docx (lightweight) for procurement to review; if the pilot budget ($8k/month) looks good we can put a 6-week pilot SOW in place.
3) Legal will prepare a standard MSA + Appendix for our data/security terms — Monica is looping in Security for any SOC 2 evidentiary items.

Logan — noting the $65k production target once scaled; if BrightLayer is willing to commit to a 6-month reserved capacity we can talk about tiered discounts.

Samantha / Jared — when would you like a 30-minute follow-up next week to review the SOW and the detailed econ scenarios? I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Thanks —
Marissa
